desc: Read N and array A from stdin.
Build an iterative segment tree (size = 1<<ceil_pow2(N)) storing pairs (value, index) to support O(log N) range argmax queries.
Set `sys.setrecursionlimit(1_000_000)` to handle worst-case recursion depth.
Query segment tree for max in `[l,r]` -> `(mx, m)`.
Recurse: `(dl, ml) = solve(l, m-1)`, `(dr, mr) = solve(m+1, r)`.
Compute `extra = max(0, abs(mx - max(ml, mr)))` (note: when subsegment empty, its mx is `-inf`, so treat accordingly).
Call `solve(0, N-1)` and print the resulting `dp` value.
Verify correctness on the provided samples (expected outputs: 5, 14, 0).
